name: pokewallet
description: PokéWallet — gerenciamento de coleção de cartas Pokémon TCG com reconhecimento por OCR

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c red,yellow "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:mobile: concurrently -k -n api,web -c red,yellow "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run start:mobile --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: npm run db:deploy --prefix backend && npm start --prefix backend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.vercel-build: npm run db:deploy --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
